policy.resolution_rule: A shared programme/action code and a similar title do not authorize aliasing two records or copying material facts between them. The candidate remains UNKNOWN when the official registry and final package identify a differently named canonical call and no official primary source establishes the candidate as a distinct opportunity.

evidence.semantic_assertion: The hash-pinned consolidated package consistently identifies STEP-LLL under Action 11.g.1. It contradicts every candidate class attached to STEP-EDU: identity/status and dates, EUR 92,000,000 rather than EUR 120,000,000, 100% grant, cumulative applicant and partner rules where universities are partners rather than the sole applicant class, and a 100-point grid with a 70-point quality threshold. status.reason: No official primary source establishes STEP-EDU as a distinct call; the same P11/11.g.1 identity is officially assigned to STEP-LLL.

deadline.reason: The candidate consultation window conflicts with the official STEP-LLL window and cannot be treated as a submission period.

budget.reason: The only current final package located for P11/11.g.1 states EUR 92,000,000 for STEP-LLL; transfer to STEP-EDU is prohibited.

grant.reason: No final guide tied to the STEP-EDU identity was found.

eligibility.reason: The candidate's university-only framing conflicts with the official STEP-LLL applicant/partner split; no distinct STEP-EDU guide resolves the collision.

scoring.reason: The STEP-LLL grid cannot be attributed to an unresolved STEP-EDU alias.

beneficiaries.reason: Universities are eligible partners in STEP-LLL, not the sole applicant class; no official STEP-EDU beneficiary rule is available.

identity_review.reason: The official evidence proves a collision but does not independently prove that no separate STEP-EDU call can ever be published.

resolution_tasks.resolution_note: All seven classes remain UNKNOWN. Resolve only when MIPE publishes a distinct STEP-EDU page/final guide with an unambiguous call identifier, or when authoritative identity evidence permits the candidate to be formally rejected or merged without duplicating STEP-LLL.
